title: 第25章 竟成了团宠第26章 富贵之家
slug: 斗罗之张三的逆袭人生
content_zh:
虽然张小彪是先出手攻击的，但张三知道对方故意趁着他在武魂附体的状态下才展开的攻击，事先还特地收起了武魂，显然没有真要趁机偷袭的意思，只是为了试探自己的能力，也有把握控制好力量不伤害到自己。
“哈！以后就拜托彪哥照拂了。”
从这件事上，张三能感觉到张小彪的成熟稳重以及一定的城府，而且这位平头少年还表现地如此通情达理，想必不会做什么多余的事情。
而且他这边隐藏实力其实也就是防止被武魂殿抓壮丁送到学院进修而已，并不是什么特别要命的事情，真暴露也就暴露了，别人宣扬出去也不会得到什么好处。
何况这个张小彪看起来也不是什么大嘴巴，不像是知道点八卦就恨不得拿着喇叭奔走相告的人，现在对方又拍着胸脯做保证，想来也是可信的。
在两人稍微又闲聊的两句后，张小彪对张三说道：“张三小弟，晚上的时候，我们这边会组织一场欢迎会。”
“欢迎会？干什么的？”
张三眉头一皱开始警觉，心道这个莫不是什么哲学交流会？
看着这个好像很和善的平头舍霸，刚刚还乐呵呵的张三顿时拘谨了起来。
“就是专门来欢迎你们这些来九舍的新人的。”
张小彪注意到张三那狐疑的视线，就摸着自己的平头笑道：
“当然不是奇怪的会，就是我们九舍的老人们出钱买好吃的好喝的，请你们这些新人和我们老人一起吃，顺便一起认识认识，以后出了这个孤儿院，我们还能相互照顾。”
“原来如此，那我也参加。”
张三心道：既然有好吃的好喝的，而且没有好看的，那当然可以参加。
张小彪点了点头又提议道：“好，现在也差不多到晚饭时间了，要不要一起吃饭去？”
“可以，正好我也饿了。”
张三对此也没有意见，也就点了点头。
“好的，吃了饭各位！”
而张小彪这时候就拍手两下，并从床边站了起来，可见其他人好像还是在凑那热闹，于是他就扯着嗓门喊道：
“王狼！朱朱！你们两个家伙别折腾了！”

“啊？老大！”
那两个还在缠斗的少年当即停下了手里的动作，屁颠屁颠的向张小彪跑来，同时其他刚还热热闹闹的孩童们也都闭上了嘴并齐刷刷的看向张小彪。
由此可见张小彪在九舍的人眼中的地位和威望。
更难得可贵的是，这些人看向张小彪的眼神并不是惶恐，而是真正的崇敬和信任。
显然张小彪并非是用武力胁迫他人以获取这个地位的。
这说明这张小彪确实担当的起这个位置，张三与其接触的时间虽短，但从其言行举止也能感觉到对方应该是个合格的领导者。
content_en:
Although Zhang Xiaobiao was the first to attack, Zhang San knew that the other party deliberately attacked while he was possessed by the martial spirit, and he put away the martial spirit beforehand. Obviously, he did not really intend to take advantage of the opportunity to attack, but just to test his own ability, and to be sure to control the power without hurting himself.
"Ha! I'll ask Brother Biao to take care of me from now on."
From this incident, Zhang San could feel Zhang Xiaobiao's maturity and a certain level of authority. Moreover, the boy with a flat head behaved so reasonably, and he would not do anything unnecessary.
Moreover, the purpose of hiding his strength is to prevent him from being captured by Wuhun Palace and sent to the academy for further training. It is not a particularly fatal thing. If it is exposed, it will be exposed, and others will not get any benefits by publicizing it.
What's more, this Zhang Xiaobiao doesn't look like a big talker. He doesn't look like someone who would rush around with a loudspeaker to tell someone if he knows some gossip. Now that the other party is patting his chest as a guarantee, it seems to be credible.
After the two chatted for a while, Zhang Xiaobiao said to Zhang San: "Brother Zhang San, we will organize a welcome party here in the evening."
"Welcome party? What's for?"
Zhang San frowned and became alert, thinking, could this be some kind of philosophy exchange meeting?
Looking at this seemingly friendly flat-headed Sheba, Zhang San, who had been cheerful just now, suddenly became cautious.
"I'm just here to welcome you newcomers to Jiushe."
Zhang Xiaobiao noticed Zhang San's suspicious gaze, touched his flat head and smiled:
"Of course it's not a strange meeting, it's just us old people from Jiushe paying for delicious food and drinks, inviting you newcomers to eat with us old people, and get to know each other by the way. After we leave this orphanage, we can still take care of each other."
"I see, then I will participate too."
Zhang Sanxin said: Since there is good food and drink, and nothing good to watch, of course you can participate.
Zhang Xiaobiao nodded and suggested: "Okay, it's almost dinner time now. Do you want to have dinner together?"
"Okay, I happen to be hungry too."
Zhang San had no objection to this and nodded.
"Okay, everyone has eaten!"
At this time, Zhang Xiaobiao clapped his hands twice and stood up from the bed. It could be seen that others still seemed to be joining in the fun, so he shouted at the top of his voice:
"Wang Lang! Zhu Zhu! You two guys, stop messing around!"
"Ah? Boss!"
The two teenagers who were still fighting immediately stopped what they were doing and ran towards Zhang Xiaobiao in a hurry. At the same time, the other children who had just been busy also closed their mouths and looked at Zhang Xiaobiao.
This shows Zhang Xiaobiao's status and prestige in the eyes of people in Jiushe.
What's even more rare and valuable is that the eyes these people look at Zhang Xiaobiao are not fearful, but true respect and trust.
Obviously Zhang Xiaobiao did not use force to coerce others to obtain this status.
This shows that Zhang Xiaobiao is indeed capable of taking on this position. Although Zhang San has been in contact with him for a short time, he can feel from his words and deeds that he should be a qualified leader.
